classification.difficultyReason: Read values and probabilities from graphs, check that probabilities sum to one, and calculate a weighted mean only for the valid graph.

content.prompt: Check whether each graph defines a valid probability distribution. For each valid distribution, find the expected value. If a distribution is invalid, explain why.

spec.description: Touching bars centred on the labelled values 1, 2, 3, 4. Decorative cyan fill omitted under house style; original bar heights retained.
spec.mathematics: Probabilities shown are 1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 1/8 respectively. Their sum is 7/8.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source-supplied graph values are visible.

answer.short: The displayed probabilities total $\frac78$, so this is not a valid probability distribution. The weighted sum of the displayed values is $\frac94$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\sum p(x)&=\frac18+\frac28+\frac38+\frac18\\\sum p(x)&=\frac78.\end{align*}$$
The probabilities do not sum to 1, so an expected value cannot be assigned to this distribution as printed. Using the displayed values gives the weighted sum
$$\begin{align*}\sum xp(x)&=1\times\frac18+2\times\frac28+3\times\frac38+4\times\frac18\\\sum xp(x)&=\frac94.\end{align*}$$
